title: District Commission must exercise powers
description: The District Commission has the same powers as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908

content.what: shall have the same powers as are vested in a civil court
conditions: while trying a suit in respect of the following matters
limitations: the summoning and enforcing the attendance of any defendant or witness and examining the witness on oath
requiring the discovery and production of any document or other material object as evidence
the requisitioning of the report of the concerned analysis or test from the appropriate laboratory or from any other relevant source
issuing of commissions for the examination of any witness, or document
any other matter which may be prescribed by the Central Government
